data.long_meaning: Garjan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'garjana', which means 'to produce a sound', specifically the sound of thunder. The name Garjan carries the meaning “Sound of thunder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Garjan usually hope their child will grow to embody sound of thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
